description: This file defines the AndroidInlineLayoutHandler class, which handles inlining of Android layout XML files within the IDE, including methods for checking if inlining is possible and performing the inlining operation.

classes.name: AndroidInlineLayoutHandler
classes.description: Handles inlining of Android layout XML files within the IDE, providing methods to check if inlining is enabled and to perform the inlining operation.

methods.name: setTestConfig
methods.description: Sets the test configuration for inlining tests.

methods.name: isEnabledForLanguage
methods.description: Checks if the handler is enabled for the given language (only XMLLanguage).

methods.name: canInlineElement
methods.description: Determines if the given PSI element can be inlined (currently always returns false).

methods.name: canInlineElementInEditor
methods.description: Checks if the element can be inlined in the current editor context.

methods.name: getLayoutUsageDataFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves layout usage data from the editor context at the caret position.

methods.name: inlineElement
methods.description: Performs the inlining of the layout element, either a file or a reference within the code.
